name: Asagiri Hotel
description: Asagiri Hotel is an editorial WordPress theme designed for airport hotels and transit hospitality, structured around the progression of a single night. Built with classic serif typography, low-key documentary photo frames, and calm responsive block patterns, it presents twenty-four-hour desk operations, room selections, shuttle schedules, and late check-in hold policies with quiet clarity.

summary.en: An airport hotel told in clock order: a dark night photograph inset in a pale page, a rooms opener with a flush-right strip, a wide photograph with a ruled card, shuttle times and a night clock.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, prices, the night-clock numerals (variable 400-700 and italic, Latin subset)
